story: Six riders break away from the start in Tour Auvergne - Rhône-Alpes Stage 2 2026. After several counterattacks, a group of four joins the leaders, who gain a significant gap. Anthon Charming launches a decisive attack with 12.2 km to go and solos to victory. The peloton remains calm, keeping Baudin in the overall lead.
